scope.claim: Compatibility obligation inventory for an independent native Rust source-to-test-result implementation. Exact named test cases identify bounded scoped scenarios to execute, not implementation status, complete capability coverage, or passing results. Any reported fraction counts only these scoped test obligations, never specification completeness. Empty test arrays explicitly identify missing evidence. An unsupported-valid rejection is not valid-program conformance. Each requirement needs feature, invalid-input rejection, cross-feature interaction, and native end-to-end evidence before any completion claim. Earlier editions and other targets require separate tested scope. The interaction matrix declares only bounded scenario axes, independently of broader semantic requirements. Every unordered pair of declared axes is an obligation, including pairs with no scenario. Listed higher-order scenarios are executable examples, not exhaustive higher-order coverage.
